photos.model

Class User

  • java.lang.Object
    • photos.model.User
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable

    public class User
extends java.lang.Object
implements java.io.Serializable
    Represents a single user of the photo application. A user has: - a unique username - a list of albums (no duplicate album names per user) Passwords are optional and can be added later if desired.
